title: tragacantha scoparia
intro: Tragacantha scoparia, commonly known as Needle Bush or Needle Thistle, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Tragacantha scoparia include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Tragacantha scoparia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
